index_edits.old: Read sequentially or jump to the owning contract:
index_edits.new: Read the owning contract and its required evidence for the subsystem you change:

index_edits.old: the gates below and the [contract index](#contract-index)

- [Owners and identities](#owners-and-identities): who owns conversations.
- [Admission](docs/contracts/admission.md#admission-and-public-requests) and [conversation/settings](docs/contracts/conversation.md#conversation-and-current-settings): configure, submit and recover replies.
- [Model requests](docs/contracts/model-io.md#model-requests-continuation-and-compaction): freeze inputs, retain output and compact context.
- [Tools and permission](docs/contracts/execution.md#model-output-tools-and-permission), including [Exact Edit](docs/contracts/execution.md#exact-edit).
- [Execution and recovery](docs/contracts/execution.md#transactions-execution-and-recovery), then [stops and outcomes](docs/contracts/sessions.md#stops-and-terminal-outcomes).
- [Inspection and local protocol](docs/contracts/inspection.md#inspection-and-local-protocol): observe, wait and control work.
- [Host lifetime/platforms](docs/contracts/host.md#platforms-and-server-lifetime) and [resources/storage](docs/contracts/resources.md#resources-storage-and-diagnostics).
- [Remaining decisions](#remaining-decisions): implementation choices and qualification still outstanding.
index_edits.new:
- For shared terms or implementation owners, read [Owners and identities](#owners-and-identities).
- For Session naming, configuration, admission, or lost replies, read [Admission](docs/contracts/admission.md).
- For Conversation entries, settings, instructions, or skills, read [Conversation and settings](docs/contracts/conversation.md).
- For frozen model requests, provider history, authentication, or compaction, read [Model requests and provider context](docs/contracts/model-io.md).
- For tool permission, Exact Edit, Bash, retries, or crash recovery, read [Tools, execution, and recovery](docs/contracts/execution.md).
- For canonical transactions, Store formats, durability, or content representation, read [Store](docs/contracts/store.md).
- For stop, archive, interruption, or Turn outcomes, read [Session stops and outcomes](docs/contracts/sessions.md).
- For CLI grammar, defaults, capture, or command output, read [CLI operations](docs/contracts/cli.md).
- For sign-in screens, Session overview, composition, choices, or terminal cleanup, read [Session UI](docs/contracts/session-ui.md).
- For reports, pages, Activity, waits, or local transport, read [Inspection and local protocol](docs/contracts/inspection.md).
- For platforms, exclusive Host ownership, or shutdown, read [Host lifetime](docs/contracts/host.md).
- For capacity, memory, scratch, or selection progress, read [Resources](docs/contracts/resources.md).
- For optional stderr, diagnostic records, or export, read [Diagnostics](docs/contracts/diagnostics.md).
- For outstanding implementation choices, read [Remaining decisions](#remaining-decisions).
